name: plugin-creator
description: Describe a plugin idea and the agent builds it: actions, skills and manifest, written into this project and loaded live so you can try it, then publish it to the store.
author: Zyvro

actions.label: New plugin from an idea
actions.description: Describe what the plugin should do; the agent designs it, writes it and checks that Studio loads it.

input.label: Your plugin idea
input.placeholder: e.g. A code reviewer that checks my changes for security issues before I commit, with a button to run it.

actions.label: Improve a plugin
actions.description: Change a plugin of this project: add an action, sharpen a skill, fix what stops it loading.

input.label: Which plugin, and what should change?
input.placeholder: e.g. commit-reviewer: also check for leaked secrets, and add a quick action that only looks at staged files.
